select aa.* from( SELECT a.ifprseq, a.ifprcategory, a.ifprtitle, a.ifprprice, a.ifprdiscout, a.ifprimfo, a.ifprorigin, a.ifprdeliveryimfo, a.ifprcomposition, a.ifprproductNumber, a.ifprinvetory, a.ifprtypeNy, a.ifprdelNy, a.ifpruseNy
ORDER BY a.ifprseq DESC ) aa limit #{rowNumToShow} offset #{startRnumForMysql}

SELECT a.ifprseq, a.ifprcategory, a.ifprtitle, a.ifprprice, a.ifprdiscout, a.ifprimfo, a.ifprorigin, a.ifprdeliveryimfo, a.ifprcomposition, a.ifprproductNumber, a.ifprinvetory, a.ifprtypeNy, a.ifprdelNy, a.ifpruseNy FROM product a WHERE 1=1 AND a.ifprseq = #{ifprseq} order by a.ifprseq DESC
